verses.zh: 以色列王大卫儿子所罗门的箴言：
verses.kjv: The proverbs of Solomon the son of David, king of Israel;
verses.en: The wise sayings of Solomon, son of David, king of Israel.

verses.zh: 要使人晓得智慧和训诲，分辨通达的言语，
verses.kjv: To know wisdom and instruction; to perceive the words of understanding;
verses.en: They help you learn to be wise, and to understand what people mean.

verses.zh: 使人处事领受智慧、仁义、公平、正直的训诲，
verses.kjv: To receive the instruction of wisdom, justice, and judgment, and equity;
verses.en: They teach you to live well: to be kind, to be fair, and to be honest.

verses.zh: 使愚人灵明，使少年人有知识和谋略，
verses.kjv: To give subtilty to the simple, to the young man knowledge and discretion.
verses.en: They make a simple person clever, and give a young person knowledge and good sense.

verses.zh: 使智慧人听见，增长学问，使聪明人得着智谋，
verses.kjv: A wise man will hear, and will increase learning; and a man of understanding shall attain unto wise counsels:
verses.en: A wise person listens and learns even more; a clever person learns how to decide well.

verses.zh: 使人明白箴言和譬喻，懂得智慧人的言词和谜语。
verses.kjv: To understand a proverb, and the interpretation; the words of the wise, and their dark sayings.
verses.en: They help you understand wise sayings, word pictures, and riddles.

verses.zh: 敬畏耶和华是知识的开端；愚妄人藐视智慧和训诲。
verses.kjv: The fear of the LORD is the beginning of knowledge: but fools despise wisdom and instruction.
verses.en: Respecting the LORD is where knowledge begins. Only fools look down on wisdom and teaching.

verses.zh: 我儿，要听你父亲的训诲，不可离弃你母亲的法则；
verses.kjv: My son, hear the instruction of thy father, and forsake not the law of thy mother:
verses.en: My son, listen to your father's teaching, and do not turn away from your mother's rules.

verses.zh: 因为这要作你头上的华冠，你项上的金链。
verses.kjv: For they shall be an ornament of grace unto thy head, and chains about thy neck.
verses.en: They will be like a beautiful crown on your head and a chain around your neck.

verses.zh: 我儿，恶人若引诱你，你不可随从。
verses.kjv: My son, if sinners entice thee, consent thou not.
verses.en: My son, if bad people try to tempt you, do not go along with them.

verses.zh: 他们若说：你与我们同去，我们要埋伏流人之血，要蹲伏害无罪之人；
verses.kjv: If they say, Come with us, let us lay wait for blood, let us lurk privily for the innocent without cause:
verses.en: They may say: Come with us! Let's hide and wait, and hurt someone who has done nothing wrong.

verses.zh: 我们好像阴间，把他们活活吞下；他们如同下坑的人，被我们囫囵吞了；
verses.kjv: Let us swallow them up alive as the grave; and whole, as those that go down into the pit:
verses.en: They say: We will swallow them up alive, like a deep pit swallowing people whole.

verses.zh: 我们必得各样宝物，将所掳来的，装满房屋；
verses.kjv: We shall find all precious substance, we shall fill our houses with spoil:
verses.en: They say: We will get all kinds of treasure and fill our houses with what we take.

verses.zh: 你与我们大家同分，我们共用一个囊袋；
verses.kjv: Cast in thy lot among us; let us all have one purse:
verses.en: They say: Join us! We will all share one money bag together.

verses.zh: 我儿，不要与他们同行一道，禁止你脚走他们的路。
verses.kjv: My son, walk not thou in the way with them; refrain thy foot from their path:
verses.en: My son, do not walk down that road with them. Keep your feet away from their path.

verses.zh: 因为，他们的脚奔跑行恶；他们急速流人的血，
verses.kjv: For their feet run to evil, and make haste to shed blood.
verses.en: Their feet run to do wrong, and they hurry to hurt other people.

verses.zh: 好像飞鸟，网罗设在眼前仍不躲避。
verses.kjv: Surely in vain the net is spread in the sight of any bird.
verses.en: It is no use setting a net where the bird can see it.

verses.zh: 这些人埋伏，是为自流己血；蹲伏，是为自害己命。
verses.kjv: And they lay wait for their own blood; they lurk privily for their own lives.
verses.en: But these people are really hiding to hurt themselves; they are trapping their own lives.

verses.zh: 凡贪恋财利的，所行之路都是如此；这贪恋之心乃夺去得财者之命。
verses.kjv: So are the ways of every one that is greedy of gain; which taketh away the life of the owners thereof.
verses.en: That is what happens to everyone who is greedy for money: greed takes away their own life.

verses.zh: 智慧在街市上呼喊，在宽阔处发声，
verses.kjv: Wisdom crieth without; she uttereth her voice in the streets:
verses.en: Wisdom calls out loudly in the street, and raises her voice in the open square.

verses.zh: 在热闹街头喊叫，在城门口，在城中发出言语，
verses.kjv: She crieth in the chief place of concourse, in the openings of the gates: in the city she uttereth her words, saying,
verses.en: She shouts at the busy corner, at the city gate, and all through the town.

verses.zh: 说：你们愚昧人喜爱愚昧，亵慢人喜欢亵慢，愚顽人恨恶知识，要到几时呢？
verses.kjv: How long, ye simple ones, will ye love simplicity? and the scorners delight in their scorning, and fools hate knowledge?
verses.en: She says: You simple people, how long will you love being foolish? How long will you laugh at what is good and hate knowing things?

verses.zh: 你们当因我的责备回转；我要将我的灵浇灌你们，将我的话指示你们。
verses.kjv: Turn you at my reproof: behold, I will pour out my spirit unto you, I will make known my words unto you.
verses.en: Turn around and listen when I correct you! Then I will pour out my spirit on you and tell you what I think.

verses.zh: 我呼唤，你们不肯听从；我伸手，无人理会；
verses.kjv: Because I have called, and ye refused; I have stretched out my hand, and no man regarded;
verses.en: I called, but you would not listen. I reached out my hand, but nobody paid attention.

verses.zh: 反轻弃我一切的劝戒，不肯受我的责备。
verses.kjv: But ye have set at nought all my counsel, and would none of my reproof:
verses.en: You ignored all my advice and would not take my correction.

verses.zh: 你们遭灾难，我就发笑；惊恐临到你们，我必嗤笑。
verses.kjv: I also will laugh at your calamity; I will mock when your fear cometh;
verses.en: So when trouble comes, I will laugh; when you are afraid, I will not feel sorry for you.

verses.zh: 惊恐临到你们，好像狂风；灾难来到，如同暴风；急难痛苦临到你们身上。
verses.kjv: When your fear cometh as desolation, and your destruction cometh as a whirlwind; when distress and anguish cometh upon you.
verses.en: Fear will come at you like a strong wind, and trouble like a storm; pain and worry will come upon you.

verses.zh: 那时，你们必呼求我，我却不答应，恳切地寻找我，却寻不见。
verses.kjv: Then shall they call upon me, but I will not answer; they shall seek me early, but they shall not find me:
verses.en: Then you will call me, but I will not answer; you will look everywhere for me, but you will not find me.

verses.zh: 因为，你们恨恶知识，不喜爱敬畏耶和华，
verses.kjv: For that they hated knowledge, and did not choose the fear of the LORD:
verses.en: That is because you hated knowing things, and did not want to respect the LORD.

verses.zh: 不听我的劝戒，藐视我一切的责备，
verses.kjv: They would none of my counsel: they despised all my reproof.
verses.en: You would not take my advice, and you looked down on every correction I gave.

verses.zh: 所以必吃自结的果子，充满自设的计谋。
verses.kjv: Therefore shall they eat of the fruit of their own way, and be filled with their own devices.
verses.en: So you will eat the fruit of what you planted, and get your fill of your own plans.

verses.zh: 愚昧人背道，必杀己身；愚顽人安逸，必害己命。
verses.kjv: For the turning away of the simple shall slay them, and the prosperity of fools shall destroy them.
verses.en: Simple people are killed by turning away, and fools are destroyed by not caring.

verses.zh: 惟有听从我的，必安然居住，得享安静，不怕灾祸。
verses.kjv: But whoso hearkeneth unto me shall dwell safely, and shall be quiet from fear of evil.
verses.en: But whoever listens to me will live safely, and rest quietly with nothing to fear.
